messages.content: 你能給我盧浮宮博物館未來3個月的展覽資訊嗎？然後告訴我巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳嗎？

function.name: restaurant_info
function.description: Get restaurant information for a specific area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Location for which to find restaurants.

food_type.description: Type of cuisine for which to find restaurants. Default is 'all' if not specified.

function.name: exhibition_info
function.description: Get exhibition information for a specific museum. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum_name.description: Name of the museum for which to find exhibitions.

month.description: Number of upcoming months for which to retrieve exhibition details. Default is 1 if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants two things:

1. Exhibition info for Louvre Museum for next 3 months.
2. Best Italian and Chinese restaurants in Paris region.

We have two functions: exhibition_info and restaurant_info. We need to call both. For exhibition_info: museum_name="盧浮宮博物館" or "卢浮宫博物馆"? The user wrote Chinese characters "盧浮宮博物館". We'll pass that. month=3.

For restaurant_info: location="巴黎地區" or "巴黎" or "巴黎地区"? The user wrote "巴黎地區". We'll pass location="巴黎地區". food_type can be "Italian" or "Chinese". We need best Italian and Chinese restaurants. We might need to call twice? The function expects one type. We could call twice: once with food_type="Italian", once with food_type="Chinese". Or we could call once with default all and then filter? But the function only returns info for one type. So we need two calls.

Thus we will call exhibition_info first. Then call restaurant_info twice. We'll produce separate calls.
